tmp:0727: ittetakh gutza — Talmudic dictum (Bava Metzia 59a) 'if your wife is short, bend down and whisper to her,' read as symbol of Malkhut/prayer in a state of smallness whose counsel must be heeded
tmp:0728: emunah be-massa u-mattan — faithfulness/honesty in business dealings, the practice through which the light of life (or ha-chayim) is drawn
tmp:0729: bo or ha-chayim — the arrival/influx of the 'light of life' (light of the Divine countenance, sign of long life) that comes through faithful commerce and mezuzah
tmp:0731: penei Hashem — the 'face of God' as symbol of Torah explanations and homiletic discourses, linked to the elder's beard and the thirteen hermeneutical middot/tikkunei dikna
tmp:0732: the flowing of all divine effluences and blessings into the world — the state of universal shefa and berakhah descending (context of the imaginative faculty resting on repeaters of halakhot)
tmp:0735: the principle that whatever a person truly and intensely desires (choshek) he can inevitably bring from potential to actuality, no obstacle withstanding sufficient longing
tmp:0736: the World to Come as the state of attaining superior comprehension of God's divinity, prompting repentance upon one's earlier repentance (honor of Olam ha-Ba)
tmp:0737: one who hears shofar-blowing from a God-fearing, trembling man — the listener to the yarei's teki'ah, thereby protected regarding the year's thunders
tmp:0738: the assurance of not worrying all year about thunder — freedom from harm/fear of ra'amim granted by hearing shofar from a God-fearer
tmp:0739: tza'ar ve-din b'olam-shanah-nefesh — suffering/harsh judgment manifesting in the three dimensions World, Year (time), and Soul (Sefer Yetzirah triad)
tmp:0740: the diminishment of the Holy One's own joy — God's grief ('He was saddened in His heart'; Shekhinah saying 'kalani me-roshi') caused by judgment in world-year-soul
tmp:0741: the man who strives to draw people near and 'make souls' for God's service — the outreach worker/mekarev (like Avraham's 'souls made in Charan') who must guard against the kelipot of those he draws near
tmp:0742: building the 'Holy Sanctuary' (heikhal ha-kodesh) — the edifice constructed spiritually by one who makes souls and brings people to divine service
tmp:0748: the joining of Emet and Emunah — union of truth (tzaddik's counsel, masculine) with faith (feminine), the coupling upon which redemption depends
tmp:0750: ish ve-ishah — the pair man-and-wife as symbol of the union of Emet (truth/husband) with Emunah (faith/wife), 'woman equated to man'
tmp:0758: the lung (re'ah) in its state of wholeness/perfection — the bodily organ whose intactness produces perfect trust (bitachon)
tmp:0759: bitachon bi-shleimut — complete trust in God, dependent on intellect ('eyes') and on the wholeness of the lungs
tmp:0760: the betrothal-bond (hitkashrut ha-zivvugim) — the engagement/connection of a couple, at which earthenware is broken, oriented toward procreation and holy bitachon
tmp:0761: bitachon di-kedushah — trust of the side of holiness, which nullifies and breaks the counterfeit trust of the Sitra Achra at the betrothal
tmp:0762: the act of studying and comprehending — the cognitive stage of learning-with-understanding that is itself called Binah (second of the three intellects)
tmp:0765: Imma — the supernal 'Mother,' kabbalistic partzuf identified with Binah (paired with Abba/Chokhmah), the Heh of Y-H, seat of mochin reached by Yesod's ascent
tmp:0766: the number forty — numerical symbol of Binah/Da'at (forty years of manna, mem = 40), signifying attained understanding
tmp:0767: Binah va-Da'at — the paired sefirotic intellects Understanding and Knowledge, symbolized by the number forty and by the manna
tmp:0768: motrot she-ba-moach — the surplus/waste-products of the brain-mochin, from which hair grows and from which enemies/external forces derive nurture
tmp:0769: binah yeteirah — the 'extra understanding' given to woman (Niddah 45b), reinterpreted as the surplus of the mochin from which hairs and hostile forces suckle
tmp:0770: binah libba — 'Binah is the heart' (Tikkunei Zohar dictum): Binah as heart-joy, one of the two 'wines' alongside the wine of Oral Torah/Malkhut
tmp:0771: binah la-ittim — 'understanding of the times' (I Chron. 12:33), the aspect of the pilgrimage festivals (regalim) to which Malkhut is elevated through rebuke
tmp:0773: beira — Aramaic 'well/pit' as symbol of parnassah, grain and sustenance (bar u-mazon), the well of livelihood
tmp:0774: the lower fear — yirah aroused by the person's own effort/initiative (as opposed to supernal fear that descends of itself), the human-generated awe that awakens shefa
tmp:0776: birsha — Aramaic word for cypress/beroshim (from Rabbah bar bar Chana tale), tree-symbol expounded in the lesson
tmp:0778: the tzaddikim of the generation seated in a circle (iggul) — the concept of the righteous positioned around the world in circular order functioning as a tribunal
tmp:0779: beit din — a court of judgment: the circle of tzaddikim as the tribunal from which each person's mishpat (merit or liability) and allotted parnassah issue
tmp:0780: beita ila'ah — the Zoharic 'Upper House,' i.e., Binah the heart, called 'Mi' (Who), paired against the Lower House Malkhut/'Zot'
tmp:0781: bekhorah — the birthright/firstborn portion ('double mouth'), taken by Yosef for guarding the brit, symbolizing prayer's twofold content (praise of God and requesting one's needs)
tmp:0785: ben zakhar — a male son/child, the offspring whose birth depends on unblemished memory (zikaron), forfeited by forgetfulness (as with Avshalom)
tmp:0786: ben chakham — the 'wise son' of the Haggadah's four sons, identified with Yitzchak (laughter/joy: 'a wise son gladdens his father')
tmp:0787: Ben Nannas — the Tanna Shimon ben Nannas (expert in monetary law, Bava Batra 175b), taken as symbol of emunah/faithful business dealing
tmp:0789: ben rasha — the 'wicked son' of the Haggadah's four sons, identified with Esav
tmp:0791: the son 'who does not know how to ask' of the Haggadah's four sons, identified with Yishmael the penitent — repentance as wordless asking of atonement
tmp:0792: ben tam — the 'simple/wholesome son' of the Haggadah's four sons, identified with Yaakov 'ish tam' (Gen. 25:27)
